_comment: Campaign-wide inventory for bridge 2 (DataflowIR -> SentientIR, the D1-D28 span).
⛔ THERE IS NO CODEQL DATABASE AND NO WAVEFRONT EXTRACTION FOR THIS CAMPAIGN, and that is a
1. The campaign's C++ surface is ONE self-contained translation unit
crustify-bridge2/source/bridge2.cpp, whose 384 function bodies call names that exist only
as SEMANTICALLY EMPTY stand-ins in source/prelude.inc. A CodeQL call graph over stand-ins
yields edges through a stub type, so it cannot order this work.
2. The dependency order is already AUTHORITATIVE and machine-readable: bridge2.cpp is emitted
in dependency order with LEVEL banners (level 0 calls nothing else in the span, level N
only levels below), and every entry carries its original dcc/src/<file>:<line> citation.
3. prelude.inc does not compile cleanly (523 clang -fsyntax-only errors, all name-resolution
in the generated stand-ins), so a database built from it would drop bodies anyway.
The wave plans under crustify/campaigns/*/ are therefore authored from those level banners; the
batch caps recorded in each schedule are wavefront's own documented defaults (translation) and
This file is the provenance the schedules record and hash. Keep it byte-stable while a wave is
in flight: `crustify translate` rejects a schedule whose oracle config changed since planning.
